title: Yellowed Crumbly Croatian Beef Casseroles
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring mixed beef cuts, mortar-pestle-pound, and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, perfect for meal prep. This cultured and crumbly casserole is a hearty meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar, pound the garlic and paprika into a smooth paste.
In a large bowl, combine the beef shank, ground beef, onion, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the garlic-paprika paste, olive oil, and tomato paste to the bowl, and mix until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish, and pour in the beef broth.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil, and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil, and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the dish from the oven, and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
